test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.**

The child said, “Will we stay here tonight?”

options.text: The child asked if we would stay there tonight.
The child asked if they will stay here that night.
The child asked if they would stay there that night.
The child asked will we stay here tonight.

solution:
The correct answer is:** The child asked if they would stay there that night. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is a **direct speech** and we need to convert it into an **indirect speech.**
 
• The given sentence is also an** interrogative sentence**.
 
• **We follow these rules in Direct-Indirect speech for an interrogative sentence:**
 
 
• **A question mark should always be used** at the end of an interrogative sentence **in direct speech.**
 
• To convert direct speech to indirect speech **quotation marks should be omitted.**
 
• **Ask** is used as reporting verb **instead of say, tell, say to. **
 
• **Interrogative sentence changes to assertive form** [direct to indirect speech]
 
• After the conversion of an interrogative sentence from direct to indirect speech, the **question mark changes to a full stop.**
 
• The conjunction **‘that’** is not used to connect reporting and reported clause.
 
• Instead **‘if’ or ‘whether’ **is used for the conversion.
 
• The modal **'will' **changes to **'would'** in the indirect part.
 
 
 
• **Example - ***I asked her, “Will you give me a pen.” (Direct)*

* I asked her if she would give me a pen. (Indirect)*

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3.**
